subject: English
passage: Throughout the 1960s, Dorothy Height worked tirelessly to advance civil rights across multiple fronts. As president of the National Council of Negro Women, she organized voter registration drives and lobbied for fair housing legislation. ______ she served as the only woman among the "Big Six" leaders who planned the March on Washington in 1963.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because "additionally" logically signals that the information in this sentence—that Height served among the "Big Six" leaders—is another instance of Height advancing civil rights, this time through her role in planning the March on Washington.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because "for example" illogically signals that the information in this sentence is an example of how, as president of the National Council of Negro Women, Height organized voter registration drives and lobbied for legislation. Instead, serving among the "Big Six" leaders is a separate instance of Height advancing civil rights, this time through march planning.
